subject.title: chatCompletions: ignore request model when x-openclaw-agent-id header is present

question: Should a valid `x-openclaw-agent-id` make `/v1/chat/completions` ignore or tolerate a generic OpenAI body `model`, despite the current documented agent-first model contract?
rationale: The implementation path is narrow, but the choice changes a public OpenAI-compatible API contract and may need parity decisions across Responses and related Gateway HTTP surfaces.

options.title: Adopt header precedence
options.body: Treat a generic body `model` as compatibility metadata when a valid agent header selects the agent, then document and test that rule.

options.title: Preserve agent-first contract
options.body: Keep requiring the body `model` to be an OpenClaw agent target and document SDK integrations to send `openclaw` or `openclaw/default` with the agent header.

options.title: Decide shared endpoint semantics first
options.body: Keep this issue open until Gateway owners choose one precedence rule for Chat Completions and the sibling endpoints that should share it.

recommendation.title: Decide shared endpoint semantics first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until Gateway owners choose one precedence rule for Chat Completions and the sibling endpoints that should share it.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc introduced the agent-first contract and related OpenAI-compatible Gateway endpoint behavior this issue would modify.
